cases.name: same-signature-in-two-files
cases.why: The same namespace reopened in two files of one module, declaring the same function twice.

cases.name: overload-across-two-files
cases.why: The same name with different parameters across the two files is an overload, and legal.

cases.name: same-class-in-two-files
cases.why: A class declared under the same namespace in both files.

cases.name: distinct-members-in-two-files
cases.why: Reopening a namespace to add different members is ordinary AngelScript.

cases.name: nested-namespace-reopened
cases.why: A nested namespace reopened across files, each file adding its own member.

cases.name: unqualified-use-across-files
cases.why: A namespaced name used without its qualifier from the other file - reported as an error, which is what the compiler calls it.
